factual_errors.claim: "Most BX11-EN units place the current weight in holding registers 40001-40002 (address 0 and 1 in zero-based Modbus addressing)."
factual_errors.why_wrong: Presented as a general/typical fact about the BX11-EN, but this is not the documented BX11-EN register layout (weight-related registers are documented at different offsets in the Baykon technical manual). It is explicitly hedged with 'check the indicator's manual to confirm,' which meaningfully reduces the risk of it being taken as final, but a specific number stated as 'most units' can still be trusted at face value by a technician who doesn't follow up.
